results: Generic two-endpoint standard roots are analytic and nonzero off the actual straight segment, square to the actual endpoint polynomial, and have explicit vertical midpoint signs for every real half-gap, including zero.

The intrinsic native high-gap factor constructs an off-gap shifted primitive and discriminant root. Their squares and trace relations are proved from the ACTUAL filled square and ACTUAL high spectral pair, not from a supplied action or root sign.

A vertical midpoint anchor and connectedness of each half-disc prove that the constructed primitive equals the ACTUAL free-normalized continued primitive plus i*n*pi on BOTH nonreal half-discs at every REAL native H-minus-one potential satisfying the proved local data. Consequently the constructed root equals the ACTUAL source-continued root there.

The constructed off-gap primitive has derivative Delta-prime divided by the constructed physical root on the entire original disc minus its actual gap segment. The root is nonzero there because the ACTUAL multiplicity-counted pair exhausts the original local radicand zeros.

The contour action is the literal one-over-pi integral of lambda*Delta-prime/root. Piecewise C1 integration by parts gives minus one-over-pi times the off-gap primitive period, retaining the actual discriminant, actual positive original index and physical unit period.

A shared logarithmic-correction primitive proves the standard-root inverse period is the negative reciprocal-pole period. The actual standard-root ellipse therefore has winding integral ONE. No contour normalization or winding hypothesis is supplied to the ellipse constructor.

Shared exact ellipse periods and cosine reflection/scaling evaluate the off-gap primitive period as minus d-squared/(pi*n) times the sine-square mean. This proves that every sufficiently small constructed positive ellipse action equals the literal TWO-over-pi real-gap boundary integral.

At a collapsed gap the off-gap primitive extends analytically through the repeated endpoint, so EVERY local contour in the punctured original disc has zero action. An actual small positively oriented circle supplies winding one. Thus a winding-one contour with exact boundary-action identity exists for EVERY ordered actual real high pair, including collapse.

For EVERY native complex q, ONE radius precedes EVERY accuracy; ONE open COMPLEX H-minus-one neighborhood and ONE cutoff precede ALL later n and ALL REAL a in that neighborhood. The actual filled square, actual pair and intrinsic root construct a winding-one contour action with norm(8*pi*n*I-(u-l)^2)<=(u-l)^2*epsilon, together with BOTH physical half-disc primitive/root identifications.

This constructs and identifies LOCAL high contour actions using the actual discriminant and physically matched root. Auxiliary-choice independence for arbitrary contours, global gluing across local squares and all indices, complex-potential analytic extension of I_n/gamma_n^2, real-valuedness/positivity and full source Theorem3.2 remain open where needed. The actual KdV Birkhoff map, actual smooth-approximation KdV flow and all five main theorems remain UNPROVED; goal ACTIVE.
